title: Archive Cellar
shortDescription: Cool roots cradle the school's paper memory.
longDescription:
Steps descend between roots thick as sleeping dragons. Labelled boxes sit above the damp on little wooden feet, and lavender sachets keep the moths diplomatically employed elsewhere.
A brass reading lamp lights a bell ledger on a sloping stand. Beneath the shelves, the roots carry a faint vibration that you feel through your soles before you hear it.

fixtures.name: Bell Ledger
fixtures.lookDescription: A blunt ledger on a sloping stand. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The ledger is blunt. The old abbey bell was taken down on a wet night. A later keeper — the hand is small, a mole's — added: its cradle was cut from the same living oak as the Collegium's foundation. On still evenings the roots answer a note, though no bell hangs. Three small circles mark the margin. The same hand signed H. there, as if two moles shared a kit. This is the paper Alder wanted — proof the bell is gone and the wood still answers. The keeper does not say where the bronze went.
